We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves. Summary Responsibilities About The Role Own the infrastructure that keeps everything running, and clear the path for everyone who depends on it. As a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer at Hummingbird, you’ll independently lead complex infrastructure, integration, and automation work across our technology environment. You’ll spend most of your day designing and maintaining our Azure infrastructure, building integrations and automation, and serving as the go-to escalation point when technical issues rise above the service desk. You’ll translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions, keep our systems secure and stable, and help teammates grow along the way. This role is a natural fit for a well-rounded engineer who has worked across many technologies rather than a single narrow lane, who takes initiative without waiting for direction, and who genuinely enjoys partnering with people across the business. What You’ll Do Lead implementation of complex integrations, automation workflows, and system connections, including work without clear precedent. Own and organize Hummingbird’s Azure infrastructure, improving cost efficiency, consistency, and alignment to best practices. Serve as the escalation point for the service desk on technical issues, including Microsoft application support such as SharePoint. Build integrations that automate manual work, such as provisioning roles and licenses across systems. Support our citizen development program by building and maintaining the infrastructure behind internally built apps. Diagnose and resolve complex, cross-system issues by tracing root causes across interconnected platforms. Strengthen system integrity and security within your scope, including access controls and validation approaches. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting, documentation, and day-to-day engineering work. Maintain clear documentation of system logic, configurations, integrations, and dependencies. Mentor engineers and raise the bar on standards for version control, testing, change management, and documentation. The Details Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent Internet service. Work Type: Full-time Compensation: Expected range is $120,800 to $157,000. New hires usually start between $120,800 and $145,000, depending on experience and internal equity. Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more Required & Desired Skills What You’ll Bring 4 to 5+ years of independent delivery in information systems, cybersecurity, IT, computer science, or a related technical discipline, including work in moderately ambiguous contexts. Advanced working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, cloud environments, and enterprise systems administration. Experience leading complex, cross-system implementation and integration work from requirements through production, and resolving issues that span multiple platforms. Solid understanding of security concepts, including access controls, authentication, IAM, and compliance frameworks. Experience designing automation that reduces manual effort and strengthens reliability. Comfort using AI-assisted tools as a core part of how you work, and openness to adopting new ones. A self-directed approach with strong initiative; you frame problems and move work forward without waiting for direction. Clear communication and a collaborative, people-first style, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical partners alike. Nice to Have Telephony experience, ideally with Genesys, or the ability to build and support telephony integrations. Background at a managed service provider or another environment that exposed you to a broad range of technologies, from infrastructure and networking to application support. Experience with scripting languages, API development, or infrastructure-as-code tooling. Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team. We’d love to meet the person behind your application. Expectations for Focus & Presence To support patients and each other, this role requires your full attention during scheduled work hours. Our Outside Employment Policy doesn’t allow overlapping work or “job stacking,” so any outside work must happen fully outside your Hummingbird schedule. We’re a camera-ready team, and you’ll need to be on camera during training and when needed during the workday after training ends. We value connection, teamwork, and being present, which is what keeps our patients safe and our team supported. If that’s what you’re looking for, you’ll feel at home here. If you’re hoping to hold another job during the same hours, this job won’t be the best match. Growth at Hummingbird This role is a key part of our technology team. You’ll take on increasingly complex infrastructure, integration, and automation challenges over time, deepen your expertise across our Azure environment, and help shape how the team works as it grows. You’ll receive coaching and feedback along the way. At Hummingbird, we believe good jobs should lead somewhere, and that starts here. Participate in network lifecycle management through build and upgrade projects. Collaborate with program and project managers to define milestones and deliverables. Execute network changes using existing procedures and tools, and develop new procedures as needed. Proficiency in scripting/automation (Python preferred) and datacenter design. Familiarity with automation frameworks, network modeling (YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF), and telemetry systems. Strong understanding of network security design, system performance testing, and operational monitoring. Excellent communication skills with proven ability to influence product direction and priorities. Collaborates with vendors and internal groups (e.g., quality assurance) to ensure hardware, firmware, software, and cloud network code. Designs playbooks for investigations to resolve common issues related to network areas. Analyzes network workflows and proposes optimizations to enhance performance and efficiency. Writes and enhances advanced scripts to automate routine tasks across teams and business units. Uses and adjusts infrastructure pipelines, configuration items, using established playbooks and resources. Independently configures tools to meet requirements of new products or services. Testing and Quality Assurance: Develops standalone, moderately complex test cases and test strategies to ensure and enhance network integrity. Serves as technical lead for test practices and strategies, providing guidance to the team and collaborating with other internal stakeholders in the development of robust testing protocols. Implements new approaches to improve break-fix validation and post-event root cause analysis (RCA), ensuring issues are resolved and lessons are integrated within the team. Conducts L1 network change reviews and creates and presents network changes to change management review boards. Collaborates with stakeholders to validate systems and environments through pre-production testing, ensuring compliance with internal standards prior to deployment. Provides audit documentation and evidence as part of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) to ensure alignment with governance and security requirements. Monitoring and Reliability: Works with others (e.g. monitoring teams) to maintain advanced dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor network health, including defining metrics, trends, and thresholds to ensure service level objectives (SLOs). Uses tools from the monitoring team to monitor alerting systems and provides feedback to enhance the detection and diagnosis of network anomalies. Participates in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations, and collaborating with stakeholders across team to resolve escalated issues. Develops and enhances tools and solutions for frontline support teams to drive efficiencies in responding to network failure conditions. Contributes to roadmap and software architecture discussions, ensuring ideas are shared within team and implemented where necessary. Collaborates with vendors and internal teams to ensure adherence to networking standards, identifying areas of misalignment and identifying resolutions. Performance and Capacity Management: Analyzes network performance and service metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, packet loss) to identify network efficiency issues and takes next steps to scale network. Uses capacity information through security and performance metrics to ensure the infrastructure can support anticipated growth.
